items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: INTERVIEWEE: On the Dixieland Jazz Band.

ctx.x: I guess about 12 years or 15 years, wasn't it, Dick? Seems to me it was about 15 years ago. You were at that session, weren't you?

No, I heard the band many times down at the Woodman of the World Hall. Yeah. We used to play on Saturday nights there. Mm-hmm. With Raymond Burke and Emil Christian. Mm-hmm. It certainly was a wonderful band. I like the ending of that particularly myself. Thank you.
Nice relax? I like the relaxedness of the record.
